initial_plan.can_answer_question: partly: the data can show the share of reported crashes with at least one motorist death, but it has no miles-driven exposure and cannot establish risk per mile
initial_plan.metric: crashes with number_of_motorist_killed >= 1 divided by all included reported crashes, by year
initial_plan.denominator: all police-reported crashes with a valid date in the same year
initial_plan.population: police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes dated from 2013 through 2025, inclusive
filters: exclude rows with missing or invalid crash_date or number_of_motorist_killed if necessary after data check
initial_plan.years: calendar years 2013-2025 inclusive, subject to data coverage checks

in every year, observed dates run from January 1 through December 31; internal date coverage was not evaluated
for every year, number_of_motorist_killed has 0 missing and 0 negative values; zero values are retained as meaningful reports of no motorist deaths
decisions: Keep dated rows in the planned years; no date-missing rows are lost, and all years pass the observed-edge coverage check
Keep zero motorist-killed values as non-events in the denominator; exclude missing or negative outcome values if present, though none were found

data_check_and_decisions.population_after_check: all 2,132,218 police-reported crash rows with dates in 2013-2025 and a nonnegative, observed number_of_motorist_killed value; all are included in their year's denominator, with crashes having zero deaths as non-events

final_plan.can_answer_question: partly: shows the frequency of a motorist death among reported crashes, not risk per mile
final_plan.metric: percentage of included reported crashes with number_of_motorist_killed >= 1, by year
final_plan.denominator: all police-reported NYC crashes in that year with an observed, nonnegative number_of_motorist_killed value
final_plan.population: police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes dated 2013-2025 with an observed, nonnegative number_of_motorist_killed value
filters: number_of_motorist_killed is not missing and is nonnegative
final_plan.limitations: No vehicle-miles-traveled or other exposure denominator is present, so this is crash-level fatality prevalence, not a per-mile risk or an individual motorist's probability. There are no missing dates, missing motorist-killed values, or negative motorist-killed values among planned rows; zero values are retained as non-events in the denominator. Each year has observed records at both date boundaries, but internal date coverage was not evaluated.
